details.root_cause_1: Dockerfile did not accept NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL as build ARG, so it was never available during npm run build
details.root_cause_2: next.config.js contained duplicated getApiBaseUrl() and an env block that hardcoded the localhost fallback at build time
details.root_cause_3: railway.json buildArgs referenced stale URL and were never consumed by Dockerfile

changes.client_ts: Migrated to NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL as canonical var with backward-compat fallback to NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
changes.next_config_js: Removed duplicated getApiBaseUrl(), rewrites(), and hardcoding env block
changes.dockerfile: Added ARG/ENV for NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_ENV before npm run build
changes.railway_json: Updated buildArgs with correct staging URL and APP_ENV=staging
